nativeAdaptation.coordinates: JavaScript numeric terminal coordinates become nonnegative cell columns and signed continuous-stream rows; pointer input is clamped before constructing a point.
nativeAdaptation.text: UTF-16 cellRangeToCharRange becomes a grapheme-safe UTF-8 byte-range conversion with the same partial-wide-cluster and zero-width-boundary rules.
nativeAdaptation.geometry: OpenTUI row lookup delegates to the already ported immutable DiffSectionGeometry and FileSectionLayout values.
nativeAdaptation.rendering: Clipboard output uses the canonical Ratatui planned-row text projections, code layout, file header formatter, and terminal sanitizer.
nativeAdaptation.state: JavaScript maps become nested Rust HashMaps keyed by file and canonical row key; the stored ranges remain inclusive.
